events.title: Myles Sanko - Flyttet Til Kulturhuset
events.description: Den internasjonalt anerkjente soul- og jazzartisten Myles Sanko slipper sitt syvende studioalbum, I See My Light, 11. september 2026. Albumet bygger videre på den personlige og kunstneriske reisen som startet med Let It Unfold (2024), og utforsker temaer som selvkjærlighet, vekst og indre styrke. Med sin karakteristiske blanding av soul, jazz og hiphop, inspirert av sine ghanesiske røtter, leverer Sanko et album preget av varme, ærlighet og håp. I See My Light markerer neste kapittel i hans uavhengige karriere, utgitt på eget plateselskap, 213 Music. I forbindelse med albumslippet legger Myles Sanko ut på en omfattende europaturné, I See My Light Tour, og kommer til SALT i Oslo torsdag 23. oktober 2026 sammen med sitt faste band. Dørene åpner kl. 19.30. Konsertstart kl. 20.00. ID: 18+. Myles Sanko har etablert seg som en av Europas mest særegne soulstemmer, og har fått ros fra blant andre MOJO Magazine, Rolling Stone og BBC Radio 6 for sin unike kombinasjon av soul, jazz og moderne uttrykk.

events.title: Oslo World: Marcel Khalife - Promises of the Storm
events.description: A Lebanese legend opens Oslo World. The Lebanese oud player, singer, and composer Marcel Khalife is a folk hero in the Arab world. With a career spanning six decades, he has combined effortless mastery of his instrument with political outspokenness and poetry. When he first set the words of the great Palestinian poet Mahmoud Darwish to music, he had no idea it was the prelude to a meeting that would forge a deep and enduring friendship between the two men a few years later---even as the songs themselves resonated across the globe. Promises of the Storm was influenced by Arab-Andalusian traditions and contemporary Middle Eastern politics. Channeling the poetry by Dahrwish and his Palestinian compatriot Izzidine Al Munassrah, Khalifé sung in colloquial Arabic. It was his way of dignifying the common people. The album became iconic in the Arab community and beyond, and to mark the fiftieth anniversary, Marcel Khalife has re-recorded it as a solo project. To have Marcel Khalife opening our festival has been a dream for many years. We are proud to present him this year, in a format stripped down to its bare essential: his magnificently seasoned tenor voice accompanied solely by his most faithful companion, the oud. After the concert in the Chateau Neuf Auditorium, the Swiss/Moroccan multi-instrumentalist Sami Galbi will play at Betong, where the opening party continues. All tickets for Marcel Khalife automatically include entry to Sami Galbi's concert at Betong later that night. Please note: The concert with Sami Galbi has an 18+ age limit, with no guardian exception.

events.title: Oslo World: Sami Galbi
events.description: Futuristic North African dance party. The Swiss and Moroccan multi-instrumentalist and producer Sami Galbi draws on the music of his childhood, which he rediscovered as an adult in the Cabarets of Casablanca: raï and chaâbi music, interpreted in Galbi's own way, with analog machines, guitar effects and synthesizer. He has emerged from the alternative scenes of Switzerland in recent years, drawing on parallel musical influences such as US hip-hop, UK bass, house and Afro-Caribbean dance music. The North African folk music of his childhood is modulated, given pop texture and a dense club atmosphere. On his debut album, YLH BYE BYE, the listener is immersed in a rich poetic where Sami Galbi's storytelling unfolds through hypnotic refrains and soaring melodies. Entirely produced by the artist, the music was mixed by Tunisian producer Ammar 808. In concert, Sami Galbi delivers high energy performances, well suited for the opening party of this years Oslo World. All tickets to the opening concert with Marcel Khalife at Chateau Neuf also automatically include admission to Sami Galbi's concert at Betong later that same evening. Please note, however, that the concert with Sami Galbi has an 18+ age limit, with no guardian exception. Therefore, children's tickets purchased for the Marcel Khalife concert cannot be used for the Sami Galbi concert.

events.title: Requiem by Torbjørn Dyrud - All Saints' Day concert
events.description: This year's All Saints' concert features the world premiere of the final work by Torbjørn Dyrud. The piece is scored for choir, narrator, string trio, and wind trio, and was commissioned by Oslo Cathedral Choir and Bergen Cathedral Choir. Between the movements, texts describing near-death experiences will be read aloud. The work will be performed simultaneously in Oslo Cathedral and Bergen Cathedral, in addition to concerts at Hoff Church on November 14 and Bragernes Church on November 15. Composer and musician Torbjørn Dyrud lived with a serious cancer diagnosis for seven years. He passed away on July 19 this year, shortly after delivering the completed work to us. During his final years, he found great comfort in accounts of near-death experiences and other similarly incomprehensible phenomena. Torbjørn was a deeply optimistic person, and part of the intention behind this work was to encourage us, here on earth, to recognize more clearly that the world is in fact filled with light and love. Near-death experiences are stories and encounters that challenge our understanding of reality at a fundamental level. Many people who have had such experiences insist that who we truly are continues to exist even after the death of the physical body. In the void left by Torbjørn's passing, we return to the intention behind the work and read what Torbjørn himself wrote in a new light: "For me, as a church musician, this literature has opened up my spiritual life in a fundamental way. It seems increasingly credible that accounts of a more real reality, beyond time and space, a state in which unconditional love fills everything, are simply true. Something within me opens up when I read these personal narratives in the light of the Bible and other historical sources." Requiem lasts approximately 45 minutes. The concert will also feature three of Torbjørn's other well-known songs and hymns composed for choir. The total duration of the concert is approximately one hour. Program: Soon She Kisses Her Friend in the Rose Garden (Snart kysser hun sin venn i rosenhagen) by Torbjørn Dyrud, with text by Inger Hagerup. Come, Breath of Life (Kom livspust) by Torbjørn Dyrud, with text by Ingrid B. Melve With a Bouquet (Med en bukett) by Torbjørn Dyrud, with text by Henrik Wergeland Requiem by Torbjørn Dyrud, with readings from accounts of near-death experiences Performers: Oslo Cathedral Choir Vivianne Sydnes, conductor Eldar Skar, Actor Brass players: Tormod Åsgård, Simen Aleksander Olsen Hagen, and Lars Brynestad String players: Sølve Sigerland, Henninge Landaas, and Ellen Margrete Flesjø (Ssens Trio) Dedicated wheelchair spaces can be purchased in the south transept. Here you can choose whether you are accompanied by a companion or not. Companions are admitted free of charge upon presentation of a companion certificate. The companion will be seated directly behind the wheelchair space. Oslo Cathedral has both a ramp and a lift to ensure step-free access. Please arrive at the main entrance, where our staff will guide you to the wheelchair entrance. A wheelchair-accessible restroom is available near the main entrance. If you wish to purchase a companion ticket without it being linked to a wheelchair space, select the ticket category "companion seat" for any other seat in the Cathedral. For questions, please contact the organizer, Oslo Cathedral Choir, at +47 977 95 450.

events.title: Xibalba 2026 – Road to Mictlan
events.description: Xibalba 2026 -- Road to Mictlan This year, Xibalba takes you deep into the ancient world of Aztec cosmology and the Mexican tradition of Día de Muertos --- bringing the colours, stories and spirit of Mexico to Oslo. Step into a world where death is not the end, but the beginning of a journey. Follow the ancient path through the different stations of the afterlife and discover what awaits beyond this world. Experience live music, visual art, powerful performances and ancient stories, inspired by the rich cultural heritage of Mexico. Enjoy authentic Mexican food and drinks as the show unfolds around you, taking you on a journey between the world of the living and the world of the dead. A celebration of life. A tribute to those we remember. A journey into the unknown. Welcome to Xibalba 2026. For more information: https://Xibalba.noXibalba 2026 -- Road to Mictlan

events.title: Le Roi David
events.description: Arthur Honegger (1892--1955) composed Le roi David in 1921 for a stage drama by René Morax. The work combines narrated text, soloists, choir, and instrumental ensemble in a form that lies somewhere between an oratorio and musical theatre. Its music brings together archaic elements, French modernism, and liturgically inspired choral writing, and the work has come to occupy an important place in the European sacred music repertoire. The story follows the biblical King David, from his youth as a shepherd and musician in the fields of Bethlehem to his reign as King of Israel. It is a narrative of triumph, doubt, and human vulnerability. In the Christian tradition, David is also associated with the authorship of several of the Psalms, making him a symbolic figure for church music, praise, and worship. Performers: Lydia Tjore Hoen, soprano Mathias Gillebo, tenor Bård Elias Nystøyl, alto Hulda Hein-Gutierrez, the witch Biskop Sunniva Gylver, narrator Stavanger Cathedral Boys Choir Trinity Girls Choir Oslo Cathedral Boys Choir Andreas Løken Taklo, piano Marcus André Berg, organ David Maiwald, organist and artistic director Accessibility: Dedicated wheelchair spaces are available in the south transept. events.title: Nøtteknekkeren – klassisk julbalett med strykekvartett
events.description: World-class performance by Etoile Production. The world-famous ballet Nutcracker performed by Ukrainian ballet stars will be a magical Christmas gift for the whole family! A beautiful fairy tale about the adventures of young Clara and the Nutcracker Prince, full of exciting stories, was transformed by Pyotr Tchaikovsky in 1892 into the world's most popular classical ballet. Today, the Nutcracker has become a global Christmas tradition, and this performance is staged annually on theater and opera stages around the world. The universal language of dance is understood without translation by any audience - the stage will present a coming-of-age story about children, revealing a young girl's fragile dream and the struggle between good and evil, where love ultimately triumphs. Dancing snowflakes, the Nutcracker Prince, toy soldiers and the Sugar Plum Fairy come to life in this magical family classic. Experience a wonderful adventure with the little girl Clara, who falls asleep on Christmas Eve. She meets her prince, faces a battle against enormous mice and rats, and is transported to the lush Sugar Land. The story is much more than just a Christmas fairy tale. It is a tale of growing up, which is also reflected in the dance. Now is the time to immerse yourself in this magical world, forget about worries and stress, remember childhood dreams and fill your soul with inspiration, warmth and new dreams. The perfect ballet for children The Nutcracker is an ideal ballet for children to experience for the first time. If you are going to the ballet with a child, we recommend reading Hoffman's Nutcracker and The Musketeer together. You can also read the libretto at https://www.kulturforfolket.com/performance/the-nutcracker, where you will find descriptions of each ballet scene that can help you answer your child's questions. In addition, this ballet will bring a sense of wonder and beauty to both young and adult audience members, filling everyone with the Christmas spirit! Authentic Classical Ballet The performance of Marius Petipa's classical choreography is performed by Etoile Production -- a company organized in Kyiv by soloists of the Kharkiv Opera and Ballet Theatre of Ukraine, Irina and Anatoly Khandazhevsky. The performers include professional ballet dancers of the highest level -- winners of international ballet competitions, Honored Artists of Ukraine, soloists of Ukrainian, and from February 2022, European theatres. The company uses authentic, handmade theatre costumes and decor in its productions. The costumes are real professional ballet costumes, carefully designed so that they do not constrain the dancers' movements and allow them to fully demonstrate their skill on stage. A professional theatre lighting designer accompanies the ballet performance and creates an unforgettable atmosphere during the show. There are no cheap decorations or flashy decorations -- only true high art of professional theatre performance. The ballet is accompanied live by a string quartet, which gives the performance an intimate and warm Christmas atmosphere. The quartet performs on stage as part of the production and plays during key scenes, creating a close connection between music and dance. In addition, the performance uses a high-quality recording of the Kharkiv Opera Orchestra, which is combined with the live quartet to support the action on stage. This is a unique opportunity to see real classical ballet of the highest level, performed by world ballet stars, with live music on stage. Ballet soloists: Irina Khandazhevskaya, prima ballerina, Honored Artist of Ukraine, soloist of the Kharkiv Opera and Ballet Theater, choreographer, diploma winner of the International Ballet Competition "Premio Roma". Honorary Prize "People's Recognition 2010" in the artist category. Awarded the "P. Virsky Prize" in the choreography category in 2007. @irinakhandazhevskaya Anatoly Khandazhevsky, soloist of the Kharkiv Opera and Ballet Theater (Ukraine), choreographer, 2nd prize winner of the international competition in Tallinn. @anatoliikhandazhevskii Maria Shupilova, soloist of the Kyiv Opera. @shupilova_maria Kristina Kadashevich, first soloist of the Kharkiv Opera and Ballet Theatre, laureate of international ballet competitions. Katerina Andrenko, soloist of the Odessa National Opera, Hamburg Chamber Ballet, Opera Poznan. @andrenko_kate Dmitry Lazovik, soloist of the Belarusian State Academic Musical Theatre, laureate of international ballet competitions. Vsevolod Maievskyi, soloist of the Dutch National Ballet, former soloist of the English National Ballet, Ukrainian-born former dancer of the Mariinsky Ballet. @vsevolod_maievskyi Larisa Hrytsay, soloist of the Kharkiv Opera and Ballet Theatre (Ukraine), soloist of the Odessa National Opera. @lorikeets89 Audience feedback: Birgitta: A wonderful break from everyday life! Beautiful costumes, skillful dancing, beautiful music and everything took me to a dream world for a while. Ami: Fantastic! The Grand Pas de deux was so beautiful that I started to cry! Ingrid: Fantastically beautiful dance and music, and beautiful costumes! The tour is presented by the Norwegian organization Kultur for Folket, a company focused on delivering high-quality cultural events. events.title: Destinations // Danseshow med OSI Gruppedans
events.description: OSI Gruppedans is thrilled to invite you to this autumn's danceshow "Destinations"! We will bring you along on an unforgettable journey through a variety of different destinations, both from our world and beyond. The audience can expect to experience the city life, outer space and magical dance pavilions, all without having to do any of the planning! All 24 numbers are choreographed by our talented instructors, and offer an array of dance styles, from ballet, jazz, modern and contemporary fusion to hiphop, girly and female dancehall -- all performed by dance-loving students! If you need to daydream yourself away from studies and work, are looking for a new holiday destination or if you're just a big dance enthusiast, all you've got to do is pack your suitcase, have your ticket ready and prepare for take-off! OSI Gruppedans is a student dance association for Oslo students under the OSI umbrella (Oslo Students Sports Club), offering dance courses in jazz, hip hop, house, modern, contemporary fusion, classical ballet, female dancehall, girly jazz and girly hip hop every semester. The courses are offered at different levels, allowing everyone to be challenged and experience the joy of dance. We work towards a dance performance every semester where the dancers can shine on stage like the stars they are! Photography: Horgen_foto Design: Iselin Charlotte Rabben Nilsen

events.title: Det Norske Kammerorkester // Amnesty og Kammerorkesteret
events.description: Gjennom 2026 har Det Norske Kammerorkester hatt et tett samarbeid med Amnesty International Norge. Gjennom ulike konserter har orkesteret løftet frem temaer fra Amnestys arbeid med menneskerettigheter. Denne kvelden er viet samarbeidet i sin helhet. Med inspirasjon fra den klassiske symfonien er konserten bygget opp i fire deler, som til sammen danner en musikalsk bevegelse. Vi begynner med å tegne opp et landskap. Deretter følger en roligere del, der vi kommer tettere på det menneskelige. Så åpner det seg igjen, med mer bevegelse og energi. Til slutt peker musikken fremover -- mot handling og håp. Med et særlig fokus på kvinners rettigheter denne kvelden, er det naturlig å la stemmene til Katarina Barruk og Ghawgha Taban bære mye av det vi ønsker å formidle. Program J. S. Bach / Max Reger - O Mensch, bewein dein Sünde gross Erkki-Sven Tüür - Action for string orchestra Ghawgha - Man Kabulam Boat Sing for me Franz Schubert - Fra Døden og piken, op. 7 no. 3 Missy Mazzoli - Vespers for Violin Arvo Pärt - Fratres for violin, strings and percussion Sanger av Katarina Barruk Medvirkende Pekka Kuusisto, kunstnerisk leder Katarina Barruk, vokal Ghawgha, vokal
